_note: Metrics for exp-027 (issue #50 block, the Qwen3.5-9B arm admitted by Jahid's reversal of ADR 0032 item 6 on 2026-09-20): Qwen/Qwen3.5-9B, unguided, 4-bit, exemplars in retrieval-rank order (as_is), ADR 0007 pinned 600, retrieval artifact runs/exp-014/retrieval/s2_pinned600_imbalanced_rerank_top5.jsonl. FOUR comparators, and the first two are CONFOUNDED BY CONSTRUCTION (ADR 0031 item 5): against exp-021 (Qwen2.5-7B) and exp-022 (Qwen2.5-14B) the model GENERATION and the PARAMETER COUNT both move, so neither pair can attribute a difference to family or to size; they place this model on the block's axis and nothing more. Against exp-020 (Mistral-7B) family, generation and size all move. Against exp-008 full_train the arm is prompting vs fine-tuning, as for every A1 arm. exp-005 is NOT a comparator: it is this model on the v1 9,156-example pool, unquantized, a different axis. Every number here is read off runs/exp-027/; nothing is inferred.

run.peak_vram_method: nvidia-smi --query-compute-apps sampled every 5 s and filtered to this run's own pid; a sampled process-reserved maximum, not torch.cuda.max_memory_allocated
run.model_size_note: 8,953,803,264 is the RUNTIME parameter count src/model_size.py reads off the instantiated Qwen3_5ForConditionalGeneration. scripts/print_model_params.py reports 9,653,104,368 for the same model from safetensors metadata, because the checkpoint also carries a 15-tensor `mtp` multi-token-prediction head the runtime model does not instantiate (difference 699,301,104). The runtime figure is the one exp-005 committed for this model_id on 2026-08-21 and the one the ceiling is asserted against. Both are under the 1.5e10 decomposer ceiling.
run.launch_gate: PASS - six preconditions (retrieval sha256 3f95c7dc...fdb0, quantization 4bit, few_shot_ordering as_is from config, evaluation_set.pinned true over 600 with 200/200/200 and 0 missing / 0 unexpected, model_size.ceiling_asserted true at 8,953,803,264 / 15,000,000,000, logging.anchor_ids_file resolved to configs/anchor_set_45.json with sha256 c03aa351...7111 and 45 ids) checked from the startup dump 15 s after launch, before generation, and re-checked against the written config.json/metrics.json plus anchor_prompts_logged 45/45 before the evaluator ran. A FIRST launch attempt at 13:21 +03 was killed by this gate at 115 s, before any generation, because the gate was armed with the 9,653,104,368 checkpoint total; nothing about the run changed, only the expected parameter count.
